title: Nagercoil custodial death revives memories of the 1996 prison killing that shook Tamil Nadu
description: While Lingam, a kabaddi player, was lodged in the Nagercoil District Sub-Jail, a gang of over 30 people broke into the prison from the outside and murdered him in 1996. He was decapitated, and his head was dumped at the Meenachipuram bus stand
